sees: frame 1: Grey striped background with headline 'WE SURVIVE BY BELONGING' at upper left, a tag 'INSIGHT 05 / 08 - DEVELOPMENT' and a 'FARSIGHTED' badge. Three abstract figures (round head over a dome body) stand close together: two small dark ones on the left and right, a small orange one in the middle and slightly lower.
frame 2: Same layout, the three figures have grown larger and moved slightly apart/right; the orange figure in the middle is bigger.
frame 3: The figures are larger still, the orange one in the centre sits between the two dark ones, all three clustered together; the text is unchanged.
changed: The three figures grow bigger (a camera push-in / zoom); the grouping stays the same.
cause: Appears to be only a slow zoom or scale-up animation; no action by any figure is visible.
effect: The orange figure stays in the middle of the two dark figures, emphasized as the one included in the group.
message: Humans survive by being part of a group, the individual (orange) is held between others.
wouldConfuse: The orange figure is a different colour and slightly lower, so it could read as an outsider or a child rather than a member; the figures have no faces, so the 'belonging' relationship is only implied by closeness.
